title: TTU vs UNT: tuition, size, accreditation
summary: Texas Tech University Health Scienes Center El Paso (TTU) versus University of North Texas Health Science Center (UNT). Also searched as UNT vs TTU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: The University of North Texas Health Science Center and Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso are both public institutions, but they differ in several key aspects. The University of North Texas Health Science Center is located in Fort Worth, while Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso is situated in El Paso. In terms of undergraduate enrollment, the University of North Texas Health Science Center has a smaller student body with 41 undergraduates compared to Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso's 242 undergraduates. Neither institution provides specific in-state tuition information.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: The University of North Texas Health Science Center and Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso do not provide specific information regarding in-state or out-of-state tuition costs. No comparable median debt information is reported for the University of North Texas Health Science Center. This financial data highlights a difference in available cost-related information between the two institutions.
